en: The Apadāna of the Elder Ekañjalika from the Suvaṇṇabibbohana Chapter (5) of the Therāpadāna I once offered a single salutation with palms joined together to the Buddha Vipassī, who was endowed with the ten powers and possessed great majesty. Because of that deed, I have been reborn in heaven for ninety-one aeons. Having passed away from there, I was born here in the human world. Having become a monk under the dispensation of the Tathāgata Gotama, I attained arahantship. My mind is liberated; I am free from all taints. I have reached the goal of my own welfare and have fulfilled the purpose of my life. I am now one who has performed his duty. This is my final birth. I shall not be subject to further existence. This is my last body. I have crossed over the ocean of saṃsāra. I have reached the further shore. I am now one who has attained the destruction of all suffering. I am one who has reached the end of the journey. I am one who has laid down the burden. I am one who has lived the holy life. I am one who has done what was to be done. I am one who has cast off the bonds of Māra. I am one who has reached the ultimate security from bondage. I am one who has attained the supreme peace. I am one who has reached the cool state. I am one who has attained the unconditioned. I am one who has reached the deathless. I am one who has attained Nibbāna. I am one who has reached the island of safety. I am one who has reached the refuge. I am one who has reached the shelter.

I am one who has reached the harbor. I am one who has reached the city of Nirvāṇa. I am one who has reached the state of no-suffering. I am one who has reached the state of no-fear. I am one who has reached the state of no-bondage. I am one who has reached the state of no-affliction. I am one who has reached the state of no-aging. I am one who has reached the state of no-death. I am one who has reached the state of no-rebirth. I am one who has reached the state of no-old-age. I am one who has reached the state of no-disease. I am one who has reached the state of no-sorrow. I am one who has reached the state of no-lamentation. I am one who has reached the state of no-despair. I am one who has reached the state of no-pain. I am one who has reached the state of no-pleasure. I am one who has reached the state of no-glory. I am one who has reached the state of no-disgrace. I am one who has reached the state of no-honor. I am one who has reached the state of no-dishonor. I am one who has reached the state of no-praise. I am one who has reached the state of no-blame. I am one who has reached the state of no-gain. I am one who has reached the state of no-loss. I am one who has reached the state of no-fame. I am one who has reached the state of no-infamy. I am one who has reached the state of no-pleasure. I am one who has reached the state of no-unpleasure. I am one who has reached the state of no-love. I am one who has reached the state of no-hatred. I am one who has reached the state of no-delusion. I am one who has reached the state of no-ignorance. I am one who has reached the state of no-view. I am one who has reached the state of no-opinion. I am one who has reached the state of no-conceit. I am one who has reached the state of no-arrogance. I am one who has reached the state of no-pride. I am one who has reached the state of no-inflation. I am one who has reached the state of no-exaltation. I am one who has reached the state of no-depreciation. I am one who has reached the state of no-elevation. I am one who has reached the state of no-depression. I am one who has reached the state of no-rising. I am one who has reached the state of no-falling. I am one who has reached the state of no-birth. I am one who has reached the state of no-death. I am one who has reached the state of no-sickness. I am one who has reached the state of no-aging. I am one who has reached the state of no-suffering. I am one who has reached the state of no-woe. I am one who has reached the state of no-peril. I am one who has reached the state of no-danger. I am one who has reached the state of no-fear. I am one who has reached the state of no-trembling. I am one who has reached the state of no-shaking. I am one who has reached the state of no-quivering. I am one who has reached the state of no-fluttering. I am one who has reached the state of no-agitation. I am one who has reached the state of no-distraction. I am one who has reached the state of no-confusion. I am one who has reached the state of no-delusion. I am one who has reached the state of no-obscurity. I am one who has reached the state of no-obstruction. I am one who has reached the state of no-hindrance. I am one who has reached the state of no-barrier. I am one who has reached the state of no-fetter. I am one who has reached the state of no-bondage. I am one who has reached the state of no-yoke. I am one who has reached the state of no-halter. I am one who has reached the state of no-restraint. I am one who has reached the state of no-control. I am one who has reached the state of no-subjugation. I am one who has reached the state of no-overpowering. I am one who has reached the state of no-overwhelm. I am one who has reached the state of no-overthrow. I am one who has reached the state of no-overturning. I am one who has reached the state of no-upsetting. I am one who has reached the state of no-disturbing. I am one who has reached the state of no-turbulence. I am one who has reached the state of no-stirring. I am one who has reached the state of no-agitating. I am one who has reached the state of no-exciting. I am one who has reached the state of no-provoking. I am one who has reached the state of no-arousing. I am one who has reached the state of no-kindling. I am one who has reached the state of no-igniting. I am one who has reached the state of no-blazing. I am one who has reached the state of no-flaming. I am one who has reached the state of no-glowing. I am one who has reached the state of no-heating. I am one who has reached the state of no-burning. I am one who has reached the state of no-consuming. I am one who has reached the state of no-devouring. I am one who has reached the state of no-eating. I am one who has reached the state of no-swallowing. I am one who has reached the state of no-chewing. I am one who has reached the state of no-tasting. I am one who has reached the state of no-smelling. I am one who has reached the state of no-touching. I am one who has reached the state of no-seeing. I am one who has reached the state of no-hearing. I am one who has reached the state of no-feeling. I am one who has reached the state of no-knowing.

I am one who has reached the state of no-perceiving. I am one who has reached the state of no-cognizing. I am one who has reached the state of no-apprehending. I am one who has reached the state of no-grasping. I am one who has reached the state of no-clinging. I am one who has reached the state of no-adherence. I am one who has reached the state of no-attachment. I am one who has reached the state of no-entanglement. I am one who has reached the state of no-involvement. I am one who has reached the state of no-engrossment. I am one who has reached the state of no-absorption. I am one who has reached the state of no-immersion. I am one who has reached the state of no-plunging. I am one who has reached the state of no-sinking. I am one who has reached the state of no-floating. I am one who has reached the state of no-surfacing. I am one who has reached the state of no-emerging. I am one who has reached the state of no-appearance. I am one who has reached the state of no-manifestation. I am one who has reached the state of no-revelation. I am one who has reached the state of no-disclosure. I am one who has reached the state of no-unveiling. I am one who has reached the state
“Under the udumbara tree, while it was in spring,
on a prepared bed of leaves,
a place to dwell was given by me.”
Of the ascetic, the great seer,
Tissa, the lord of bipeds,
the protector of the world, the one who is such (tādin).
Having raised my hands in reverential salutation,
I spread out a bed of flowers.
Ninety-two aeons ago from now,
Because I made that flower-strewn carpet,
I do not know a state of misery;
this is the fruit of that carpeting.
In this fourteenth aeon,
I was a lord of men,
known by the name Eka-añjalika.
A wheel-turning monarch of great power.
The four analytical knowledges... [and so forth]...
“Such is the teaching of the Buddha.
Thus indeed did the venerable Elder Ekañjalika speak these verses.
This is the fifth legend (Apadāna) of the Elder Ekañjalika.
